desc: After HPM-only transition/rollback passes, build one exact composed artifact: replay the proven ticket-105 HPM transition, keep that host state active while bringing up right eUSB2 repeater + T6040 ATC + DART/xHCI, enumerate, then run the proved inverse/rollback.
